items.title: Pay invoice for leaf removal and gutter cleaning
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie innerhalb von 10 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung.
items.computation: The payment period is set as 10 days 'nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung' (after receipt of this invoice), not from the invoice date. The invoice itself carries no printed document date, and the letter does not state when it was actually received by the recipient. Without either an issue date or a known receipt date, the start of the 10-day period cannot be fixed, so the exact due date cannot be computed. If, for illustration, the invoice were received on the day it is dated, the 10 days (calendar days, §187 Abs.1, §188 Abs.1 BGB, counted from the day after receipt) would end on a date 10 days later, shifted to the next business day if it fell on a weekend or NW public holiday (§193 BGB) since this is a payment obligation to a private company (no statutory authority deemed-delivery rules apply here). Because the anchor date is missing, no reliable due_date can be given.

warnings: The invoice has no printed date (document date), and the letter does not state when it was received, so the exact payment due date (10 days after receipt) cannot be calculated; the recipient should check the envelope postmark or their own records for the actual receipt date to work out the real deadline.

The IBAN (DE78 3705 0198 0005 5141 40) is well-formed and passes the checksum check, but this only confirms the IBAN's format, not that it belongs to Hausmeisterservice Beispielhand; the recipient's bank will also run a payee-name match (Empfängerüberprüfung) before transferring, which should be heeded if it reports no match.
